algorithms.name: cancel a pending tool execution
algorithms.html: To cancel a pending tool execution given a traversable navigable traversable and a unique internal value uuid:

steps.html: Assert: these steps are running in parallel.
If traversable’s pending tool executions map[uuid] does not exist, then return.
Let execution be traversable’s pending tool executions map[uuid].
Remove traversable’s pending tool executions map[uuid].
Let targetDocument be execution’s target document.
Queue a global task on the webmcp task source given targetDocument’s relevant global object to run the following steps:
Let localExecutions be targetDocument’s associated ModelContext’s internal context’s local pending tool executions map.
If localExecutions[uuid] does not exist, then return.
Let localExecution be localExecutions[uuid].
Remove localExecutions[uuid].
Signal abort on localExecution’s abort controller.

algorithms.name: unloading-document-cleanup-steps
algorithms.html: This specification’s unloading document cleanup steps, given a Document document, are as follows:

steps.html: Let traversable be document’s node navigable’s traversable navigable.
Run the following steps in parallel:
Let executionsToRemove be an empty list.
For each uuid → execution of traversable’s pending tool executions map:
If document is execution’s target document or document is execution’s caller document, then append uuid to executionsToRemove.
For each uuid of executionsToRemove:
Let execution be traversable’s pending tool executions map[uuid].
If document is execution’s target document and is not execution’s caller document, then run execution’s completion steps given null and false.
Otherwise, if document is execution’s caller document and is not execution’s target document, then cancel a pending tool execution given traversable and uuid.
Otherwise, Remove traversable’s pending tool executions map[uuid].
Assert: traversable’s pending tool executions map[uuid] does not exist.

algorithms.name: notify documents of a tool change
algorithms.html: To notify documents of a tool change given a Document tool owner and a list of origins exposed origins, run these steps:

steps.html: Assert: these steps are running in parallel.
Let navigablesToNotify be tool owner’s node navigable’s traversable navigable’s inclusive descendant navigables.
For each navigable of navigablesToNotify:
Let targetDocument be navigable’s active document.
If targetDocument is not allowed to use the "tools" feature, then continue.

If tool is exposed to an origin given tool owner’s origin, exposed origins, and targetDocument’s origin, then queue a global task on the webmcp task source given targetDocument’s relevant global object to fire an event named toolchange at targetDocument’s associated ModelContext.

algorithms.name: tool is exposed to an origin
algorithms.html: To determine if a tool is exposed to an origin given an origin tool owner origin, a list of origins exposed origins, and an origin accessing origin, run these steps:

steps.html: If tool owner origin is same origin with accessing origin, then return true.
For each allowed origin of exposed origins:
If accessing origin is same origin with allowed origin, then return true.
Return false.

algorithms.name: tool execute steps
algorithms.html: The tool execute steps, given a string toolName, a Document targetDocument, a string inputArguments, an algorithm completionSteps, and a unique internal value uuid, are as follows. The completionSteps algorithm takes a string-or-null result and a boolean success.

steps.html: Assert: these steps are running on targetDocument’s relevant agent’s event loop.
Let toolMap be targetDocument’s associated ModelContext’s internal context’s tool map.
If toolMap[toolName] does not exist, then run completionSteps given null and false, and abort these steps.
Let tool be toolMap[toolName].
Run tool’s execute steps given targetDocument, inputArguments, completionSteps, and uuid.

algorithms.name: imperative execute steps
algorithms.html: The imperative execute steps, given a ModelContextTool tool, a Document targetDocument, a string inputArguments, an algorithm completionSteps, and a unique internal value uuid, are as follows:

steps.html: Assert: these steps are running on targetDocument’s relevant agent’s event loop.

Let inputObject be the result of parse a JSON string to a JavaScript value given inputArguments and targetDocument’s relevant realm. If exception was thrown, then run completionSteps given null and false, and abort these steps.
If inputObject is not an Object is false, then run completionSteps given null and false, and abort these steps.
Let controller be a new AbortController created in targetDocument’s relevant realm.

Let localExecution be a new local pending tool execution with the following items:

abort controller

controller
Set targetDocument’s associated ModelContext’s internal context’s local pending tool executions map[uuid] to localExecution.

Let options be a new ToolExecuteCallbackOptions dictionary, with the following fields:

signal

controller’s signal
Let toolPromise be the result of invoking tool’s execute with inputObject and options.
If <var>toolPromise</var> was fulfilled with value <var>v</var>:
Let localExecutions be targetDocument’s associated ModelContext’s internal context’s local pending tool executions map.
If localExecutions[uuid] does not exist, then return.
Remove localExecutions[uuid].
Let serializedResult be the result of serializing a JavaScript value to a JSON string given v. If this throws an exception, run completionSteps given null and false, and abort these steps.
Run completionSteps given serializedResult and true.

additional.html: If <var>toolPromise</var> was rejected with reason <var>r</var>, then:

steps.html: Optionally report a warning to the console describing r.
Let localExecutions be targetDocument’s associated ModelContext’s internal context’s local pending tool executions map.
If localExecutions[uuid] does not exist, then return.
Remove localExecutions[uuid].
Run completionSteps given null and false.

algorithms.name: model context/unregister a tool
algorithms.html: To unregister a tool given a ModelContext modelContext and a string tool name, run these steps:

steps.html: Assert: these steps are running on modelContext’s relevant agent’s event loop.
Let tool map be modelContext’s internal context’s tool map.
If tool map[tool name] does not exist, then return.
Let exposed origins be tool map[tool name]'s exposed origins.
Remove tool map[tool name].
Let targetDocument be modelContext’s relevant global object’s associated Document.
In parallel, notify documents of a tool change given targetDocument and exposed origins.

algorithms.html: The modelContext getter steps are:

steps.html: Return this’s associated ModelContext object.

algorithms.name: ModelContext/registerTool(tool, options)
algorithms.html: The registerTool(tool, options) method steps are:

steps.html: Let global be this’s relevant global object.
Let tool owner be global’s associated Document.
If tool owner is not fully active, then return a promise rejected with an "InvalidStateError" DOMException.

If this’s surrounding agent’s agent cluster’s is origin-keyed is false and this’s relevant settings object’s origin’s scheme is not "file", then return a promise rejected with a "SecurityError" DOMException.
If tool owner is not allowed to use the "tools" feature, then return a promise rejected with a "NotAllowedError" DOMException.
Let tool map be this’s internal context’s tool map.
Let tool name be tool’s name.
Let tool title be tool’s title.
If tool map[tool name] exists, then return a promise rejected with an InvalidStateError DOMException.
If tool name or description is an empty string, then return a promise rejected with an InvalidStateError DOMException.

If either tool name is the empty string, or its length is greater than 128, or if tool name contains a code point that is not an ASCII alphanumeric, U+005F (_), U+002D (-), or U+002E (.), then return a promise rejected with an InvalidStateError DOMException.
Let stringified input schema be the empty string.

If tool’s inputSchema exists, then set stringified input schema to the result of serializing a JavaScript value to a JSON string, given tool’s inputSchema. If this threw an exception, then return a promise rejected with that exception.
If options’s signal exists and is aborted, then return a promise rejected with options’s signal’s abort reason.
Let exposed origins be an empty list of origins.
If options’s exposedTo exists, then:
For each origin of options’s exposedTo:
Let parsedURL be the result of running the URL parser on origin.
If parsedURL is failure or its origin is not potentially trustworthy, then return a promise rejected with a "SecurityError" DOMException.
Append parsedURL’s origin to exposed origins.
Let promise be a new promise created in this’s relevant realm.
If options’s signal exists, then:
Let signal be options’s signal.
If signal is aborted, then return a promise rejected with signal’s abort reason.
Add the following abort steps to signal:
Unregister a tool given this and tool name.
Reject promise with signal’s abort reason.

Let tool definition be a new tool definition, with the following items:

name

tool name

title

tool title

description

tool’s description

input schema

stringified input schema

execute steps

An algorithm that takes a Document targetDocument, a string inputArguments, an algorithm completionSteps, and a unique internal value uuid, and runs the imperative execute steps given tool, targetDocument, inputArguments, completionSteps, and uuid.

annotations

null if tool’s annotations does not exist. Otherwise, an annotations with the following items:

read-only hint

tool’s annotations’s readOnlyHint

untrusted content hint

tool’s annotations’s untrustedContentHint

consequential hint

tool’s annotations’s consequentialHint

exposed origins

exposed origins
Set this’s internal context’s tool map[tool name] to tool definition.
Run the following steps in parallel:
Notify documents of a tool change given tool owner and exposed origins.
Queue a global task on the webmcp task source given global to resolve promise with undefined.
Return promise

algorithms.name: ModelContext/getTools(options)
algorithms.html: The getTools(options) method steps are:

steps.html: Let global be this’s relevant global object.
Let toolRequestor be global’s associated Document.
If toolRequestor is not fully active, then return a promise rejected with an "InvalidStateError" DOMException.

If this’s surrounding agent’s agent cluster’s is origin-keyed is false and this’s relevant settings object’s origin’s scheme is not "file", then return a promise rejected with a "SecurityError" DOMException.
If toolRequestor is not allowed to use the "tools" feature, then return a promise rejected with a "NotAllowedError" DOMException.
Let from origins be an empty list of origins.
If options’s fromOrigins exists, then:
For each origin of options’s fromOrigins:
Let parsedURL be the result of running the URL parser on origin.
If parsedURL is failure or its origin is not potentially trustworthy, then return a promise rejected with a "SecurityError" DOMException.
Append parsedURL’s origin to from origins.
Let promise be a new promise created in this’s relevant realm.
Run the following steps in parallel:
Let tools be an empty list of RegisteredTool dictionaries.
Let navigables be toolRequestor’s node navigable’s traversable navigable’s inclusive descendant navigables.
For each navigable of navigables:
Let targetDocument be navigable’s active document.
If targetDocument is not allowed to use the "tools" feature, then continue.
Let targetOrigin be targetDocument’s origin.
Let callerOrigin be toolRequestor’s origin.
If toolOwnerIsRequested be true if targetOrigin is same origin with callerOrigin, or if from origins contains targetOrigin; otherwise, false.
If toolOwnerIsRequested is false, then continue.
Let targetToolMap be targetDocument’s associated ModelContext’s internal context’s tool map.
For each tool name → tool definition of targetToolMap:
If tool is exposed to an origin given targetOrigin, tool definition’s exposed origins, and callerOrigin returns false, then continue.

Let registeredTool be a new RegisteredTool dictionary, with the following fields:

name

tool definition’s name

title

tool definition’s title if it is non-null; otherwise the empty string.

description

tool definition’s description

inputSchema

the result of parse a JSON string to a JavaScript value given tool definition’s input schema, if tool definition’s input schema is not the empty string; otherwise undefined.

window

targetDocument’s relevant global object

origin

targetOrigin, serialized.

annotations

if tool definition’s annotations is not null, a ToolAnnotations dictionary whose readOnlyHint is tool definition’s annotations’s read-only hint, untrustedContentHint is tool definition’s annotations’s untrusted content hint, and consequentialHint is tool definition’s annotations’s consequential hint.
Append registeredTool to tools.
Sort in ascending order tools, with a being less than b if a["name"] is code unit less than b["name"].
Queue a global task on the webmcp task source given global to resolve promise with tools.
Return promise.

algorithms.name: ModelContext/executeTool(tool, inputObject, options)
algorithms.html: The executeTool(tool, inputObject, options) method steps are:

steps.html: Let callerDocument be this’s relevant global object’s associated Document.
If callerDocument is not fully active, then return a promise rejected with an "InvalidStateError" DOMException.

If this’s surrounding agent’s agent cluster’s is origin-keyed is false and this’s relevant settings object’s origin’s scheme is not "file", then return a promise rejected with a "SecurityError" DOMException.
If callerDocument is not allowed to use the "tools" feature, then return a promise rejected with a "NotAllowedError" DOMException.
Let expectedTargetOriginURL be the result of parsing tool’s origin.
If expectedTargetOriginURL is failure, or expectedTargetOriginURL’s origin is an opaque origin, then return a promise rejected with a "NotSupportedError" DOMException.
Let expectedTargetOrigin be expectedTargetOriginURL’s origin.
Assert: expectedTargetOrigin is not an opaque origin.
Let inputArguments be the result of serializing a JavaScript value to a JSON string given inputObject. If this threw an exception, then return a promise rejected with that exception.
Let promise be a new promise created in this’s relevant realm.
Let targetWindow be tool’s window.
Let targetDocument be targetWindow’s associated Document.
Let uuid be a new unique internal value.
If options’s signal exists, then:
Let signal be options’s signal.
If signal is aborted, then return a promise rejected with signal’s abort reason.
Let traversable be targetDocument’s node navigable’s traversable navigable.
Add the following abort steps to signal:
Reject promise with signal’s abort reason.
In parallel, cancel a pending tool execution given traversable and uuid.
Run the following steps in parallel:

If targetDocument’s node navigable’s traversable navigable is not callerDocument’s node navigable’s traversable navigable, then queue a global task on the webmcp task source given callerDocument’s relevant global object to reject promise with an "UnknownError" DOMException, and abort these steps.
Let targetOrigin be targetDocument’s origin.
Let callerOrigin be callerDocument’s origin.

If targetOrigin is not same origin with expectedTargetOrigin, then queue a global task on the webmcp task source given callerDocument’s relevant global object to reject promise with an "UnknownError" DOMException, and abort these steps.
Let targetToolMap be targetDocument’s associated ModelContext’s internal context’s tool map.
Let toolName be tool’s name.

If targetToolMap[toolName] does not exist, then queue a global task on the webmcp task source given callerDocument’s relevant global object to reject promise with an "UnknownError" DOMException, and abort these steps.
Let tool definition be targetToolMap[toolName].

If tool is exposed to an origin given targetOrigin, tool definition’s exposed origins, and callerOrigin returns false, then queue a global task on the webmcp task source given callerDocument’s relevant global object to reject promise with an "UnknownError" DOMException, and abort these steps.
Let completionSteps be an algorithm that takes a string-or-null result and a boolean success, and runs the following steps:
Assert: these steps are running in parallel.
If targetDocument’s node navigable’s traversable navigable’s pending tool executions map[uuid] does not exist, then return.
Remove targetDocument’s node navigable’s traversable navigable’s pending tool executions map[uuid].
If success is true, then queue a global task on the webmcp task source given callerDocument’s relevant global object to resolve promise with result.
Otherwise, queue a global task on the webmcp task source given callerDocument’s relevant global object to reject promise with an "UnknownError" DOMException.

Let execution be a new pending tool execution, with the following items:

caller document

callerDocument

target document

targetDocument

tool name

toolName

completion steps

completionSteps
Set targetDocument’s node navigable’s traversable navigable’s pending tool executions map[uuid] to execution.
Queue a global task on the webmcp task source given targetWindow to run the tool execute steps given toolName, targetDocument, inputArguments, completionSteps, and uuid.
Return promise.

algorithms.name: perform an observation
algorithms.html: To perform an observation given a top-level traversable traversable, run these steps:

steps.html: Assert: This algorithm is running in the browser agent’s AI agent queue.
Assert: traversable’s active document is fully active.
Let observation be a new observation.
Let flat descendants be the inclusive descendant navigables of traversable’s active document.
For each navigable descendant of flat descendants:
Let document be descendant’s active document.
Let id be document’s unique ID.
Set observation’s tool map[id] = document’s associated ModelContext’s internal context’s tool map’s values, which are tool definitions.

Perform any implementation-defined steps to add anything to observation that the user agent might deem useful or necessary, besides just populating the tool map. This might include annotated screenshots of the page, parts of the accessibility tree, etc.

Perform any implementation-defined steps with observation and the browser agent, to expose the observation’s tool map to the browser agent in whatever way it accepts.

Implementations are expected to convey to the browser agent any relevant security information associated with tool definitions, such as the originating origin, among other things, so that the backing model has an idea of the different parties at play, and can most safely carry out the end user’s intent.
